title: DANAHER CORP /DE/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Danaher Corporation entered into a new $5.0 billion 364-day revolving credit facility on April 16, 2026, with Bank of America as Administrative Agent. The facility expires April 15, 2027, and carries interest at Term SOFR plus 58.5-108.5 basis points depending on Danaher's credit rating. Proceeds are intended for commercial paper liquidity support and general corporate purposes.
key_points: Danaher signed a $5.0 billion 364-day revolving credit facility on April 16, 2026
Facility expires April 15, 2027; can be converted to term loans upon payment of 0.50% fee
Interest rate: Term SOFR plus margin of 58.5 to 108.5 basis points based on credit rating
Consolidated Leverage Ratio covenant of 0.65 to 1.00 or less required
Facility is unsecured; Danaher guarantees subsidiary borrower obligations
Intended use: commercial paper program liquidity and general corporate purposes
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate credit facility filing. It provides no insight into macro catalysts or market structure. The filing is relevant only to Danaher's debt investors and does not constitute market-moving information.
